title: Add semantic computation protocols
summary: Define protocols such as toLatex, evaluate, differentiate, matrixForm, graphForm, numericSample, solveStep, and explainTransform for semantic objects that qualify.

sourceRefs.summary: Current expression AST and computation-friendly symbolic model.
Current surface examples that connect math objects to rendered graph/surface forms.
Semantic matrix object model and likely matrix-form protocol target.
Expression-level regression tests for computation semantics.

verification: npm test -- tests/math-expression.test.ts tests/latex-to-expression.test.ts tests/semantic.test.ts tests/equation-graph.test.ts
expectedLearning: Which semantic object families can safely expose computation protocols now and which need narrower templates or examples.
How to show the same object through LaTeX, graph, matrix, numeric sample, and explanation views without conflating type with presentation.
allowedWork: Define capability-style protocols for qualifying semantic objects rather than making every object implement every operation.
Attach initial computation protocols to expression, matrix, graph, and LaTeX-backed objects where current tests can validate behavior.
Add catalogue metadata so the dashboard can show what protocols an object supports.
disallowedWork: Do not build a complete CAS or theorem prover.
Do not make convenience templates such as identity matrix into separate semantic types unless they carry distinct structural semantics.
Do not add animation behavior in this slice except metadata needed to connect computation protocols to existing views.
